# Third-party software

`zxing-browser-0.2.1.min.js` is the pinned UMD distribution of
[`@zxing/browser` 0.2.1](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@zxing/browser),
used as the local QR scanning fallback when the browser does not implement
`BarcodeDetector`.

The package is distributed under the MIT License. Its upstream license text is
stored next to this notice as `ZXING-LICENSE`.
